paragraphs: Hünkar beğendi, or the sultan’s delight, pairs a concentrated Turkish lamb stew with a silky béchamel-bound purée of flame-blackened eggplant and mild aged cheese.

Hünkar beğendi means the sovereign liked it and belongs to Ottoman Turkish cuisine. Its defining pleasure is the contrast between tomato-braised lamb and genuinely smoke-charred eggplant folded into béchamel; plain mashed eggplant or cheese-heavy sauce loses that balance. This Kwilt version follows the reviewed household adaptation: Keep the authoritative two-component structure and honest weekend timing; use accessible lamb shoulder and mild aged cheese without simplifying away the smoke-charred eggplant.

paragraphs: Etli biber dolması is the meat-filled branch of Turkish stuffed peppers, combining raw rice, seasoned beef, herbs, and tomato inside upright peppers that simmer gently in a shallow tomato broth.

Dolma comes from the Turkish verb meaning to fill. Turkey has many meatless, meat-filled, hot, and cold branches; this etli biber dolması is the everyday hot main-dish form with beef, rice, tomato, herbs, and yogurt, not the olive-oil currant-and-pine-nut version served cool. This Kwilt version follows the reviewed household adaptation: Follow the Turkish ministry's accessible household meat-filled branch, add explicit safe-temperature and expansion controls, and use the familiar stuffed-pepper description before the Turkish name.
